ticker_news.title: Technical Analysis For Trading SPY And Top Tech Stocks, As Market Braces For Fed Rate Decision
ticker_news.description: The article provides technical analysis and price levels for trading SPY, QQQ, and top tech stocks like Apple, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Alphabet, Meta, and Tesla. It highlights key support and resistance levels, as well as potential bullish and bearish scenarios for each stock, ahead of the upcoming Federal Reserve interest rate decision.
ticker_news.author: Rips Benzinga Contributor

ticker_news.title: Investors Bet on Broadcom’s AI Future Amid $75B+ Hyperscaler Spend
ticker_news.description: Broadcom is well-positioned to benefit from the continued investment in AI infrastructure by major tech firms like Alphabet, Meta, and Microsoft. These companies are reporting strong AI-driven growth and increased capital expenditures, signaling a robust demand outlook for Broadcom's AI-related products.
ticker_news.author: Marketbeat.Com
